_readme: Copy to guides/<Slug>.check.json and edit. Drives checks_gold4.py (the GOLD5 gate).
Exit 0 = deployable. Exit 1 = HOLD. --no-render skips ONLY the browser stage; never skip it before a deploy.
mapsTokens: every Maps link must contain one of these (catches links pointing at the wrong continent).
staleTokens: place words from the guide you cloned. Matched on word boundaries.
staleAllow: {token: [exact phrase]} — exempts ONLY that reviewed phrase, for when a stale token is a real fact here and not a leftover. Every other occurrence still fails.
groups: 2 or 3. Use 3 when the guide has a street-food group (GOLD5 §3).
hot: turns on the freshness gate for the What's-hot-this-month board (GOLD5 §10).
